name: Condensate polishing systems for HRSG / once-through boilers (filtration, ion exchange; conductivity/sodium ta
description: Remove ionic and particulate contaminants (sodium, chloride, sulfate, silica, iron/copper oxides) from returned condensate and makeup before it reaches the boiler/steam generator, protecting boilers, turbines and HRSG evaporators from scaling, corrosion, hydrogen damage and turbine deposition (Graver; Chemical Engineering/ChemTreat). Primary source: https://www.chemengonline.com/monitoring-water-steam-chemistry-steam-generators/
